description: Dear Friends and Neighbors, I am humbled and honored to have the opportunity to represent my community and District 78 for two more years in the SC House of Representatives. I could not have accomplished this without the incredible support, guidance and love from my family, friends, and supporters like you! Although the campaign has ended, my work has never stopped. I will continue to fight for the issues most important to our community and state. Thank you! Best,

title: We did it! Thank you!
